description: This file defines the Layout class used within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for chart layout configurations. It manages properties related to chart label positioning, size, visibility options, and styling such as colors and fonts. The class provides getter and setter methods for manipulating these properties.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents the layout configuration for chart labels and other graphical elements, including position, size, color, font, and visibility properties.

methods.name: getShowLegendKey
methods.description: Returns whether legend keys are shown.

methods.name: setShowLegendKey
methods.description: Sets whether to show legend keys.

methods.name: getShowCatName
methods.description: Returns whether category names are shown.

methods.name: setShowCatName
methods.description: Sets whether to show category names.

methods.name: getShowSerName
methods.description: Returns whether series names are shown.

methods.name: setShowSerName
methods.description: Sets whether to show series names.

methods.name: getShowBubbleSize
methods.description: Returns whether bubble sizes are shown.

methods.name: setShowBubbleSize
methods.description: Sets whether to show bubble sizes.

methods.name: getShowLeaderLines
methods.description: Returns whether leader lines are shown.

methods.name: setShowLeaderLines
methods.description: Sets whether to show leader lines.

methods.name: getLabelFont
methods.description: Returns the font used for labels.

methods.name: getNumFmtLinked
methods.description: Returns whether number format is linked.

methods.name: setNumFmtLinked
methods.description: Sets whether number format is linked.
